query: SELECT (s.ordinal::text||':'||t.ordinal::text) AS "sequence!" FROM assistant_conversation_turns t JOIN assistant_conversation_sources s ON s.workspace_id=t.workspace_id AND s.conversation_id=t.conversation_id AND s.id=t.source_id WHERE t.workspace_id=$1 AND t.conversation_id=$2 ORDER BY s.ordinal DESC,t.ordinal DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT 1
